name: pnp-sp-dev-spfx-web-parts-react-workflow-approval-dashboard
title: Workflow & Approval Status Dashboard
shortDescription: A read-only SharePoint Framework dashboard for displaying workflow and approval status from bounded SharePoint REST list sources.
longDescription: This sample uses bounded SharePoint REST list sources to display workflow and approval status, including request details, approvers, stages, due dates, and overdue markers. It is intentionally read-only and never controls a workflow.
